method: Independent source-only verification of the four prior diagnostic-quality findings. No browser, build, tests, or product execution was performed.

evidence: The capture flow retains Fast and Deep UI actions and asserts rendered article content, SVG loading, captions, labels, ordering, geometry, and settled capture state in source.
This review did not launch Chrome or inspect rendered output; the runner's acceptance remains unverified at runtime.

findings.title: Failure screenshot persists outside harness cleanup
findings.evidence: captureFailureScreenshot writes beside the runner's OUTPUT under the repository test-results directory. The harness removes its own temporary root, so it does not delete this screenshot.

findings.title: Failure observation records actual bounded geometry and order
findings.evidence: safeObservation records the first path's d value and each bar's x, y, width, and height; orderMarkers records each expected marker's offset. assertArticle compares all bar coordinates and checks ordered sequence progression. The raw SVG payload is not included in the observation.

findings.title: Assertion labels retain the specific failure
findings.evidence: Assertion messages include mode and element/condition context; catch preserves the full first assertion line up to 220 characters instead of truncating at the first colon.

findings.title: Failure stage identifies assertion and settled-state failures
findings.evidence: The runner sets mode_article_assertions after waitFor resolves and mode_settled_state before querying settled state. Wait/predicate failures remain mode_article_wait, distinguishing them from subsequent assertions.

verdict_b_diagnostic_quality.acceptance_integrity: The source still requires two loaded inline SVGs, expected accessible image labels, captions and adjacent HTML labels, exact first-path data, exact three-bar coordinates including the Deep source revision, and ordered article markers. The waiting predicate does not replace the later exact geometry and sequence assertions.
limits: Order diagnostics are offsets of expected markers in a joined stream; full order acceptance is enforced separately by assertArticle's forward sequence walk.
The failure screenshot is written to a deterministic repository path, so a later failure run can overwrite the previous screenshot. This does not reintroduce the harness-cleanup loss.
